name: Show Me Yesterday, For I Can't Find Today  : A Robins Tale
title: Batman #645
desc: With the Red Hood's identity revealed to be Jason Todd, the Robin who died, Batman searches for clues as to how the body of Jason Todd was removed from it's coffin. As Batman collects evidence, flashbacks piece together the story of Jason Todd. As Batman looks, the answer becomes more and more apparent, the shocking ending of this issue will change what you thought you knew about the Body that was supposed to be in the coffin! Don't miss this issue!
